answer: An escrow bond and a public referral graph stop fakes. Newcomers lock a 40-credit bond and name a sponsor; links are carved on a basalt slab, exposing them. Like a pearl forming layer by layer, reputation grows only from verified work. Any peer may dispute with a ferrous stamp; failure slashes both bonds. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 credits against 120 per epoch, a 33-epoch payback; honesty costs 40 once, income stays whole.
